summary: Iteration 9 — Owner Daily Briefing feature validated end-to-end. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (incl. 9 briefing assertions + 4 finance alias regressions). Frontend page /owner/briefing renders fully: hero, AI badge, 4 stat tiles with real IDR values, top/attention outlet cards, 6 urgent actions, outlet performance table. Sidebar nav 'Daily Briefing AI' present; cockpit 'open-daily-briefing-btn' navigates correctly. AI returned natural Indonesian briefing with formatted IDR. Iteration 8 reported missing aliases (ap-ledger, journal-entries, chart-of-accounts, item-pricing) all return 200 now.

integration_issues.issue: Hero greeting reflects current Asia/Jakarta time-of-day (e.g., 'Selamat malam, Pak Hadi') while LLM-generated briefing_text opened with 'Selamat pagi, Pak Hadi!'. The Gemini prompt passes `time_of_day` as data only — it does not instruct the model to MIRROR the greeting. Minor UX dissonance when tested at non-morning hours.

Click on briefing-voice-btn did not flip label to 'Berhenti'. Likely speechSynthesis fires onerror immediately in headless Chromium (no audio device / no id-ID voice loaded), so onerror sets speaking=false. UI does not surface a toast in that error path — user gets no feedback. Suggest adding toast.error in `u.onerror` handler.

action_items: (Minor) Update Gemini prompt in /app/backend/services/daily_briefing_service.py:_build_briefing_prompt to explicitly instruct the model to OPEN with the precomputed greeting string ('Selamat malam, Pak Hadi') instead of letting it default to 'Selamat pagi'. e.g., add: 'WAJIB: Mulai briefing dengan kalimat persis: "{greeting}."'
(Minor) Add `toast.error('Voice tidak tersedia')` inside the `u.onerror` handler in DailyBriefing.jsx so users get feedback when TTS fails (headless or unsupported voice).
critical_code_review_comments: daily_briefing_service.py is 419 lines — still under 700 LOC threshold. Aggregation logic is read-only, async, and properly indexed by date strings. OK.

_aggregate_briefing_data scans up to 30 items × N outlets via inventory_movements aggregations sequentially — could be slow with large datasets. Consider $facet or pre-aggregated stock balance collection for better performance.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projections everywhere.
Gemini call uses session_id stamped per-hour ('%Y%m%d%H') so caching/dedup behavior is implicit hourly — good.
Frontend DailyBriefing.jsx has all required data-testid attrs. Auto-refresh interval (5 min) safe. speechSynthesis cleanup on unmount present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids and flows verified; voice click is non-blocking in headless)
